action: Update NetScaler ADC and Gateway to 13.1-64.39 or 14.1-73.57, FIPS builds to 14.1-73.58 or 13.1-37.293, NetScaler Console to 14.1-74.34, and Secure Access Client to 26.10.4 (Linux) or 26.11.16 (Windows). Read the linked Citrix bulletins first.
exec: NetScaler gateways are frequent attack targets; the national advisory is a prompt to schedule these updates, though it reports no exploitation.
plain: Canada's cyber agency told organisations using Citrix NetScaler remote-access equipment and the Citrix Secure Access Client to install new security updates.

key_findings: Affected: NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway before 13.1-64.39 and 14.1-73.57, and ADC FIPS builds before 14.1-73.58 FIPS and 13.1-37.293 FIPS and NDcPP.
Also affected: NetScaler Console before 14.1-74.34 and Secure Access Client before 26.10.4 (Linux) and 26.11.16 (Windows).
The advisory text names no CVEs; linked Citrix bulletins cite CVE-2026-120869 (Console), CVE-2026-118269 (Linux client) and CVE-2026-118268 (Windows client).
No CVE is identified for NetScaler ADC or Gateway on the page, and exploitation is not mentioned.
recommendations: Review the Citrix security bulletins linked from the advisory.
Apply the necessary updates as they become available.

sources.name: Defcon Level (mirror of Cyber Centre advisory)

summary: Cyber Centre advisory AV26-1150 points Canadian organisations to Citrix bulletins covering NetScaler ADC and Gateway before 13.1-64.39 and 14.1-73.57, FIPS builds, NetScaler Console before 14.1-74.34 and the Secure Access Client for Linux and Windows. The advisory body lists no CVEs; the linked Citrix bulletins name three, for Console and the two clients. It makes no statement about exploitation.
title: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security issues Citrix NetScaler advisory AV26-1150

validation.note: CVE-2026-118269 was not found in NVD at the last check. CVE-2026-118268 was not found in NVD at the last check.

review.note: Compared products, fixed versions and CVEs against CCCS AV26-1150 and mirror
